blurb: Experience the thrill of skydiving in Palatka, FL! Skydive Paltka offers tandem skydives for first-timers & AFF certification for aspiring jumpers. Enjoy breathtaking views of North Central Florida. Book your jump today! We are a full-service skydiving training center and a USPA Group Member
